summary: The Lakers dossiers were broadly accurate on current facts (roster, coach, Christmas, Cup, Specter reveal) because they were seeded with verified data. Three live spot-checks confirmed the Oct 21 home opener, the gold E Line, and Pann's still open. Real errors fixed: the Forum Blue history in uniform.json, Reaves's Arkansas origin, Reaves's number (15), the Specter merchandise already released Sept 9, Icon/Association color labels, and shaky specifics (Kuya Lord in Lomita, Born x Raised founders, Tanter, Drew League-Nike). Strategy needs edits for the Specter launch timing, Icon naming, Kuya Lord and stale verify items. Remaining risk sits in venue/store status, ownership, statue roster and partner availability.
